input: 销售部2025年总收入是多少？
output: SELECT SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM financial_metrics JOIN departments ON financial_metrics.department_id = departments.id WHERE departments.name = '销售部' AND year = 2025

input: 生产部6月的收入、成本和净利润
output: SELECT revenue, cost, net_profit FROM financial_metrics WHERE department_id = 2 AND year = 2025 AND month = 6

input: 市场部2025年上半年的净利润总和
output: SELECT SUM(net_profit) AS total_net_profit FROM financial_metrics WHERE department_id = 3 AND year = 2025 AND month BETWEEN 1 AND 6

input: 2025年各月全公司的总收入趋势
output: SELECT month, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(cost) AS total_cost, SUM(net_profit) AS total_net_profit FROM financial_metrics WHERE year = 2025 GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

input: 各部门2025年平均毛利率排名
output: SELECT departments.name AS department_name, AVG((revenue - cost) / revenue * 100) AS avg_gross_margin FROM financial_metrics JOIN departments ON financial_metrics.department_id = departments.id WHERE year = 2025 GROUP BY departments.name ORDER BY avg_gross_margin DESC

input: 销售部2025年各月的毛利率变化
output: SELECT month, (revenue - cost) / revenue * 100 AS gross_margin FROM financial_metrics WHERE department_id = 1 AND year = 2025 ORDER BY month

input: 最近有哪些高危异常指标？
output: SELECT departments.name AS department_name, metric_label, actual_value, expected_range, deviation_pct, severity, description FROM anomalies JOIN departments ON anomalies.department_id = departments.id WHERE severity = 'high' ORDER BY deviation_pct DESC

input: 哪个部门2025年现金流最好？
output: SELECT departments.name AS department_name, SUM(cash_flow) AS total_cash_flow FROM financial_metrics JOIN departments ON financial_metrics.department_id = departments.id WHERE year = 2025 GROUP BY departments.name ORDER BY total_cash_flow DESC

input: 销售部2025年下半年的应收账款情况
output: SELECT month, accounts_receivable, revenue, accounts_receivable / revenue AS ar_ratio FROM financial_metrics WHERE department_id = 1 AND year = 2025 AND month BETWEEN 7 AND 12 ORDER BY month

input: 对比销售部和生产部2025年Q1的净利润
output: SELECT departments.name AS department_name, SUM(net_profit) AS q1_net_profit FROM financial_metrics JOIN departments ON financial_metrics.department_id = departments.id WHERE year = 2025 AND month BETWEEN 1 AND 3 GROUP BY departments.name ORDER BY q1_net_profit DESC
